subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on July 15th, 2022. Your flight details are as follows: Flight number XYZ123, departure time 10:00 AM, seat 23A. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels, The Airline Team
